Network Map

Connections are extracted from the researcher's sources (vault screenshots/notes and X posts). "alleged" means unconfirmed by the source; nothing here asserts wrongdoing.

Legend

verified — source states it as extracted
corrected — fixed after checking the source (original reading kept)
alleged — not clearly stated / unconfirmed by the source
𝕏 X-post relationship (purple, curved edge; status in the panel)
person · person (X only) · organization
Node size = number of connections. Edge colour = strongest status among the selected statuses.
